dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Oh my days, I can't even bear to keep reading this... Look, based on my own painful experience, here's a breakdown of the most common scams. If you're reading this, count yourself lucky."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The ■■■■ trick. In this scam, the scammers usually claim to have ■■■■... And as long as you jump in ■■■■ early, you can be part of ■■■■."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "In the first few months, maybe ■■■■... Your 'partners' might suddenly ■■■■. And as it turns out, ■■■■ would already be ■■■■."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This type of trick clings to our local scammers like stench clings to a dead dog."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But no matter how skilled a scammer may be, they'll fold the moment you ask, "■■■■," my friends..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Who erased my message?! Darn and blast, it's definitely one of those filthy scammers! Did anyone see who did it?"
